blocks.text: Functional group interconversion (FGI) ka matlab aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna hai, jaisa kisi khaas compound ki synthesis ke liye zaroori ho. FGI target molecules tak raaste banane mein ahem kirdar ada karta hai: saada shuruati maadde FGIs ko bunyadi juzw bana kar zyada pecheeda targets mein badle ja sakte hain, aur FGI carbon dhaancha banane aur raasta chunne dono mein madad deta hai. Pichhle chapters mein aaye interconversions neeche khulasa hain.

blocks.alt: Do carbon wale compounds ke darmiyan tabdeeliyon ka naqsha: alkene, halogenoalkane, amine, aldehyde, alcohol, amide, ester, carboxylic acid aur acid halide; teeron par reagents: HBr, KOH (alcohol), NH3, Heat/H2SO4, H2O/H2SO4, PBr3, KOH (aq), K2Cr2O7/H2SO4, NaBH4, V2O5, LiAlH4, C2H5OH/H+, SOCl2.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.3: Aliphatic organic compounds mein functional group interconversion (kitab ki Figure 25.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har teer aik reaction hai jo pichhle chapters mein parha. Kitab ke Figure 25.3 mein alcohol se amide tak aik seedha teer 'NH3' bhi chhapa hai; yeh sahi nahi, kyunke ethanol ammonia se ethanamide nahi banata (amide ke liye carbonyl group chahiye). Is liye hamare khaake mein woh teer nahi rakha gaya. Amide sahi tor par carboxylic acid ya acid halide se NH3 ke saath banta hai, jaisa naqshe mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: Beech mein benzene: CH3Cl/AlCl3 se oopar toluene; SO3/H2SO4 se baen benzene sulfonic acid, phir (i) NaOH (ii) HCl se neeche phenol; HNO3/H2SO4 se daen nitrobenzene, phir Sn, HCl se neeche aniline; ethanoyl chloride/AlCl3 se neeche acetophenone. Toluene se (i) Cl2, roshni (ii) KOH(aq) ke zariye benzyl alcohol aur KMnO4/H2SO4 se benzoic acid.
blocks.caption: Figure 25.4: Aromatic organic compounds mein functional group interconversion (kitab ki Figure 25.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Benzene se teen alag electrophilic substitution reactions (alkylation, sulphonation, nitration) aur aik acylation shuru hoti hain; phir doosra qadam naya group deta hai. Kitab ke Figure 25.4 mein naam 'benene sulfonic acid' chhapa hai; sahi hijje 'benzene sulfonic acid' hain.

blocks.prompt: Aldehydes aur ketones aasani se nucleophilic addition kyun karte hain?
blocks.explanation: C=O group polar hai, is liye carbonyl carbon delta+ hai aur nucleophiles ko kheenchta hai; is ka pi bond aasani se toot'ta hai; aur hamwar (trigonal) carbonyl carbon oopar ya neeche se hamle ke liye khula hai.

blocks.prompt: Carboxylic acid ko us ke anhydride mein kaise badla ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Do tezaab molecules se taqatwar dehydrating agent, jaise P4O10, ke saath garam kar ke paani nikalein: 2CH3COOH -> (CH3CO)2O + H2O; ya tezaab ko acyl chloride (SOCl2) mein badal kar sodium namak se react karayein: CH3COCl + CH3COONa -> (CH3CO)2O + NaCl.

items: FGI: aik functional group doosre mein.
Aliphatic aur aromatic FGI naqshe Chapters 20 se 24 ke reactions jorte.
